geometry_policy: Official UrbIS geometry remains authoritative. Photo-guided street furniture is visual-only until replaced by surveyed/open-data positions.

references.subject: Atomium approach
references.license: CC0 / public domain as stated by source

current_visual_rules.building_facades: procedural shader remains temporary; building footprints remain UrbIS; facade colour/window pattern is not parcel-specific yet
current_visual_rules.atomium_approach_furniture: aligned to nearest official UrbIS StreetAxes geometry; lateral offsets and spacing are photo-guided, not surveyed
current_visual_rules.building_heights: DSM-DTM height pass is active: 9163 of 9518 official building footprints use p75 per-pixel DSM-DTM derived heights; 355 currently use the documented 10.5 m fallback. See building_height_integration_validation.json for tested counts and quality classes.
current_visual_rules.building_height_quality_gate: do not replace DSM-derived heights with generic storey defaults; investigate the 355 fallback footprints progressively using better source coverage
current_visual_rules.photo_match: Atomium benchmark camera is provisional. Jette references may include depicted-place coordinates, but those must never be treated as photographer coordinates unless the source explicitly provides camera position.

measured_height_validation.method: p75 of valid DSM-DTM pixel heights whose pixel centres fall inside the official UrbIS building footprint
